title: Finite-free ramified coefficient stages without a geometric base
statement: Let $\ell$ be prime and let $E\subseteq F$ be finite extensions of $\mathbf Q_\ell$, equipped with their compatible extending absolute values. Let $R=\mathcal O_E$, $S=\mathcal O_F$, and let $t\in R$, $v\in S$ be uniformizers [def-weil-l-adic-coefficient-extension]. Then $S$ is a finite free $R$-module. There are a unit $u\in S^\times$ and an integer $e\geq1$ such that $t=uv^e$. For every $n\geq1$, $t^nS=v^{en}S$, and the induced map $R/t^nR\to S/t^nS=S/v^{en}S$ is finite free. These are finite local rings annihilated by powers of $\ell$. The indices $en$ are cofinal in the positive integers, and the ideals and quotient maps are independent of unit changes in the chosen uniformizers.
